blind.description: A stone baluster-style pillar candlestick holding a thick wax candle. It features a square stone base with subtle moss accents, a curved central baluster column, and a square stone top with an inset circular candle dish. Sitting in the dish is a short, thick yellow pillar candle with melted wax drips running down the sides and a small unlit black wick at the center. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A square grey outline enclosing a circular basin containing a yellow circular candle top with a central black dot (wick) and small wax drips extending outwards.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands just under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 feet tall), with a base width roughly half the width of the figure's cylinder body.
